name: io.github.ahmad-codex/workstream-mcp
title: Workstream
description: Shared task ledger for AI agents and humans: atomic claims, state machine, GitHub and Slack sync

environmentVariables.name: WORKSTREAM_DB_CONNECTION
environmentVariables.description: Npgsql connection string for the PostgreSQL 16 database

environmentVariables.name: WORKSTREAM_ADMIN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the /admin API, used to create users

environmentVariables.name: WORKSTREAM_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public base URL used when returning user MCP URLs

environmentVariables.name: WORKSTREAM_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your user token from POST /admin/users. Only used to build the client URL; the server does not read it.
